shown.message:
Outline rev. 15 needs nothing from me. Fig 6 (the λ clip) moved to the appendix because the 8 main pages leave no float room. The clip stays as one Results paragraph that states the formula, the two real sets and the n ≳ 300 condition.

`story-repo`#11 is still open and unanswered. It asks for the finite-pool wording to claim the pattern rather than "within ±0.02 per cell". I added one comment to it about the paper's appendix section "Finite-population check". That section doesn't claim "within Monte Carlo error", but it shows only the three cells that agree best. It leaves out gene_expression n = 500 and 1000 and galaxies n = 1000, where the approximation misses by 0.02–0.04. I suggested one added clause that states those differences. The conclusion is unchanged.

The paper reports 12.8 CPU-hours against the roughly 8 CPU-hour planning estimate, and says so, so I raised nothing on that.

I'll re-review when `story-repo` answers or the paper text changes.
